originality.rationale: The submitted "new symmetry identification" of the affine augmentation character was already proved in a 2026-10-18 full result. More decisively a 2026-11-01 full result proves that the entire degree-two integral C17 translation module is the augmentation ideal I of Z[C17]. Together with the actual geometric inversion action iota t iota^-1=t^-1 and the established rational involution trace zero, this entails the proposed mod-two eigensum obstruction, even though the earlier text does not display that final index. In I/2I=F2[t]/Phi17(t), Phi17 factors into two irreducible factors of degree eight (ord_17(2)=8); inversion sends a root to its 16th power and preserves each F256 factor. Any semilinear involution is x->u x^16 with u u^16=1; finite-field Hilbert 90 conjugates it to x->x^16. Thus each factor contributes rank four to (iota-I), total rank eight. The integral eigensum bounds in the submitted proof then force (Z/2)^8. It is a corollary of already published stronger integral module coverage and standard finite-field algebra, not a novel independent invariant.
residual_risks: Exact semilinear factor argument relies on the published integral augmentation-module theorem being valid; its all-text proof was inspected, not independently re-proved from raw covering-chain data.
